### PgFoundRow(PgHeapTuple, ushort, PgTimestampTz?, uint)

Describes a row that [Find(PgHeapTuple)](/api/ankus.pgrelationwriter/#member-52c29b397670c43d) found and locked, and the transaction that
wrote it.

```csharp
public PgFoundRow(PgHeapTuple Row, ushort CommitOrigin, PgTimestampTz? CommitTime, uint TransactionId)
```

Parameters:

`Row` — [PgHeapTuple](/api/ankus.pgheaptuple/)

The row's values.

`CommitOrigin` — [ushort](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint16)

The replication origin of the transaction that wrote the row, or zero when it was
            written locally or PostgreSQL does not track commit timestamps.

`CommitTime` — <code>PgTimestampTz?</code>

The time that transaction committed, or null when <code>track_commit_timestamp</code> is off or
            the time is no longer known.

`TransactionId` — [uint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint32)

The ID of that transaction.
